questions.solution:

questions.question: The difference between a discount of 40% and two successive discounts of 30% on a certain bill was ₹220. Find the amount of the bill (in ₹).
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Difference between two discounts = Rs.220

Discount (D) = 40%

Two successive discounts

Discount (D₁) = 30%; Discount (D₂) = 30%

**Formula used:**

Equivalent discount (D) = D1 + D2 - (D1 × D2)/100

**Calculation:**

Equivalent discount (D) = 30 + 30 - (30 × 30)/100

⇒ 60 - 9 = 51%

Difference in discount = (51 - 40)% = 220

⇒ 11% = 220

⇒ 1% = Rs.20

Marked price (M.P) = 100% = 20 × 100 = Rs.2000

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.2000.**

questions.question: What is the area of the sector of a circle of radius 8 cm formed by an arc of length 12 cm?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of an arc = 12 cm

Radius of circle = 8 cm

**Formula used:**

Length of an arc = (2 × π × R × θ)/360

Area of sector = (π × R2 × θ)/360

**Calculation:**

Length of an arc = (2 × π × R × θ)/360

⇒ 12 × 360 = 2 × (22/7) × 8 × θ

⇒ θ = (12 × 360 × 7)/(22 × 16)

⇒ θ = (3 × 45 × 7)/11

⇒ θ = (945/11)° 

Area of sector = (π × R² × θ)/360

⇒ (22/7) × (8)² × (945/11) × (1/360)

⇒ 2 × 16 × 3 × (1/2) = 16 × 3

⇒ 48 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 48 cm2.**

questions.question: The curved surface area of a solid circular cylinder of height 12 cm is 2640 cm². What is the volume (in cm³) of the cylinder? (Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Height of cylinder (H) = 12 cm

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2640 cm²

**Formula used:**

Curved surface area = 2 × π × R × H

Volume of cylinder = π × R² × H

Where, R = radius; H = height

**Calculation:**

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2640 cm2

⇒ 2 × π × R × H = 2640

⇒ (22/7) × R × 12 = 1320

⇒ 12 × R = 60 × 7

⇒ R = 35 cm

The volume of cylinder = π × R2 × H

⇒ (22/7) × (35)² × 12

⇒ 22 × 5 × 35 × 12 = 46200 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 46200 cm3.**

questions.solution:

Rate = (1200 × 100)/(9000 × 4)

questions.question: The effective speed of a boat is 15.2 km/h against the stream and 20.8 km/h along the stream. Find the speed of the stream.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Upstream speed = 15.2 km/h

Downstream speed = 20.8 km/h

**Formula used:**

Upstream speed = U - V

Downstream speed = U + V

**Calculation:**

Upstream speed = (U - V) = 15.2 km/h

Downstream speed = (U + V) = 20.8 km/h

Speed of stream (V) = (20.8 - 15.2)/2 = 5.6/2 = 2.8 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 2.8 km/h.**

questions.question: If r = 15 (sin θ + cos θ) and s = 16 (sin θ - cos θ), then the value of (r²)/(15²)+(s²)/(16²) is ________.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

r = 15 (sin θ + cos θ)

s = 16 (sin θ - cos θ)

**Formula used:**

Sin² θ + cos² θ = 1

(A + B)² = A² + B² + 2 × A × B

(A - B)2 = A2 + B2 - 2 × A × B

**Calculation:**

⇒ r = 15 (sin θ + cos θ)

Squaring both sides

⇒ r² = {15 (sin θ + cos θ)}²

⇒ 225 × (sin² θ + cos² θ + 2sin θ cos θ)

⇒ r2 = 225 × (1 + 2sin θ cos θ)

s = 16 (sin θ - cos θ)

Squaring both sides

⇒ s2 = {16 (sin θ - cos θ)}2

⇒ 256 × (sin2 θ + cos2 θ - 2sin θ cos θ)

⇒ s2 = 256 × (1 - 2sin θ cos θ)

Now,

(r²)/(15²)+(s²)/(16²) = 225 × (1 + 2sin θ cos θ)/225 + 256 × (1 - 2sin θ cos θ)/256

⇒ 1 + 2sin θ cos θ + 1 - 2sin θ cos θ

⇒ 2 

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**
